prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: SIMPLIFIED GAME-READY CHARACTER DESIGN SHEET for GALE BREAKER. Input image 1 is an identity reference ONLY. Redesign its four characters into MUCH SIMPLER, charming, expressive low-poly 3D fighting-game characters suitable for an indie Godot game. This must look like an achievable inexpensive stylized in-game model lineup, NOT detailed promotional illustration and NOT realistic humans. Dramatically simplify geometry, anatomy, materials and costumes. Clean broad faceted surfaces, flat local color, two-tone cel shading, NO photorealistic skin, NO textures, NO pores, NO fabric weave, NO embroidery, NO tiny hardware, NO complex layered kit, NO cracks covering every surface. A slightly exaggerated cartoon adult anatomy, readable heads and larger hands/feet; about five-to-six head proportions, no infant/chibi bodies. Clear silhouettes at small screen size, clean visible articulated joints and short uncomplicated costumes with no cloth simulation. Matte almost textureless colors, simple studio shadows, pale neutral gray background.

Board layout: wide landscape, four columns, large FULL-BODY THREE-QUARTER game-model pose per character occupying the upper two-thirds, smaller clear simplified FRONT and BACK turnaround underneath each one, four flat palette swatches. Keep every view for each character consistent. Only small heading "GALE BREAKER / GAME-READY" and labels "KAZE", "IGNIS", "TOPHIA", "VOLT". Do not add little equipment close-ups, annotations, paragraphs or decorative borders. Keep front/back technical poses simple and not crowded. Shared stylization and scale across all four; Kaze tallest and thin, Ignis widest and heaviest. Model clearly shown including hands and feet.

KAZE: tall slender BALD adult male monk, completely shaved head, calm face drawn with a handful of bold shapes, straight UPRIGHT posture, jade-green single-wrap sleeveless tunic and roomy green trousers ending above ankles, simple dark green cloth belt. One short robe panel at the hip, no trailing ribbons and no complex bead necklace. BARE FEET with toes represented as a simple clean low-poly shape. Only 4 colors: jade green, dark green, warm skin, cream. Simple faceted long limbs, calm open palm. No headband, no hair, no ninja armor.

IGNIS: giant hulking adult male country bruiser, rounded heavy torso, huge rounded shoulders, exaggerated HUNCHED posture and big simple fists. ONE simple brown cowboy hat, SHIRTLESS, blue denim-colored plain jeans, brown chunky cowboy/work boots, simple belt. Defining sunburn is a CLEAN FLAT COLOR BLOCK: red sunburned head/neck/shoulders and BOTH arms; clearly PALE WHITE untanned chest and belly, with an obvious sharp tan line. No realistic mottled skin. One simple blocky beard if needed. No muscles rendered with intricate anatomy, no hair-by-hair detail, no gauntlets, no armor, no jewelry. Approachable but powerful country brawler.

TOPHIA: adult female earth fighter with practical dark tied hair, dynamic twisting fighting stance and asymmetrical wide planted legs. Armor made of just a FEW LARGE STONE PIECES: one simple stone chest slab, two large stone shoulder blocks, two stone forearm cuffs, simple knee/shin blocks over dark flexible leggings. Large clean beveled gray rock forms, very few facets, not hundreds of shards, no busy cracks or gold filigree. One ochre waist sash and tiny amber mineral accent. Exposed joint gaps for rigging, face readable, no helmet. Strong diagonal silhouette despite simplified model.

VOLT: young ADULT male handmade-tech tinkerer, spiky blond hair made of just 5–7 simple chunky clumps with dark scorched tips, small soot cheek mark. Navy sleeveless utility shirt and dark plain trousers, a few mismatched flat cream/ochre armor plates attached with broad straps, ONE small square cyan chest power cell, TWO chunky homemade forearm modules and ONE simple cable loop connecting a small back battery. Graphite and cyan identity with pale yellow hair. Clearly HANDMADE AND IMPROVISED technology, but very FEW PARTS; no exoskeleton covered in greebles, no dozens of exposed wires, no massive backpack, no tiny bolts. Simple work boots, open face, no visor obscuring eyes.

All four should be appealing, distinctive, production-friendly low-poly game designs, preserving the exact new identities. Emphasize restrained shape and color choices rather than surface detail. Avoid resemblance to existing franchise characters. No watermarks.
